inputs:lc/names-2026-09-27.title: LC Name Authority File (MADS/RDF, N-Triples), 2026-09-27
inputs:lc/names-2026-09-27.description: The complete LC Name Authority File (LCNAF) in MADS/RDF as N-Triples, bulk export of id.loc.gov (dcterms:issued 2026-09-27, dcterms:modified 2026-09-13 in names.madsrdf.nt.json, which is the description file of the export), downloaded 2026-10-16. One block per authority record (# BEGIN/# END comments) with its Real World Object (rwo/agents) and blank nodes. The SHA-1 stated in the description file (c56cf844…) does not match the downloaded file (37dfc78a…); the archive is intact (gzip -t). Public domain (id.loc.gov/about).
inputs:lc/names-2026-09-27.note: Not published: a copy of a public source, the input of the dataset lc (decision 0029).
